confusing: Slide 10: 60x vs 90x vs 30x vs 4x within one slide
Slide 10: MuJoCo run through Python mj_step loop on 11 cores is not a fair speed baseline
Slide 9 walker contact curves diverge visibly after 0.6 s
doubts: 60x headline when baseline is a 3D general solver stepped from Python
Walker physics match: red and dashed curves clearly differ in collapse case, RMS 0.195 and 0.562
questions: What does the speed look like against MuJoCo MJX or Warp on a GPU, or batched C++ MuJoCo rollouts?
Any stacking, self-collision or non-ground contacts?
Step size and substeps equal on both sides?

fixes.change: Lead with the honest 'same algorithm, same Python ops: 3.7x GPU, 33x fusion' apples-to-apples split and move 60x vs MuJoCo to a footnote labelled 'Python loop baseline'
